pathBase: batch directory (modules/index.json assetBase); flat exports use their containing directory

nodeAssignments.canonicalization: Sort [nodeId, profileId] pairs lexicographically; encode compact JSON as UTF-8.

poolSemantics.primaryPools: Ordered preferred complete composition candidates for this exact profile. New batch-06 assets appear where available; unchanged profiles retain batch-05 candidates. Not an active runtime binding.
poolSemantics.fallbackPools: Ordered complete earlier batch-05 candidates for manual review if the primary is unsuitable. Not an automatic runtime failover.
poolSemantics.selection: Choose a complete candidate within the exact profileId. Props are optional compositional accents. Do not randomly mix grounds, backdrops or props across regions. Arrays permit future alternatives; no weights or runtime selection behavior are defined.
poolSemantics.sharedInteriors: Shared interior backdrops and props are explicitly permitted only where referenced; regional ground candidates do not make the whole interior bespoke.

coverage.note: Ashen Crown forest is preserved with zero node assignments. Exact assignments remain in source, not copied here.
